verdict.rationale: Amend design: drop tool_success_rate entirely from LocalAnalyticsRepositoryRow (backend) in favor of raw tool_calls/tool_calls_success only; add one shared frontend calcToolSuccessRate() helper used at the two row-construction points (branch-row mapping and aggregateRepos) instead of keeping a backend-sent percentage alongside new raw counts. Confirmed safe: tool_success_rate on this schema is pure derived data, not used for sorting/filtering, consumed nowhere outside codemie-ui; LocalAnalyticsUserRow (Users tab) is a separate schema and is unaffected.
User approved amended plan.md (tool_success_rate removed from API, single calcToolSuccessRate helper added).

Backend (codemie) review: approve, 0 findings (blind lens failed twice, reduced coverage noted, accepted as-is). Frontend (codemie-ui) review: request-changes - CR-001 (calcToolSuccessRate needs Number.isFinite guard against NaN) and CR-002 (needs clamp to 0-100 against malformed counts). User chose to fix CR-001/CR-002 before approving.
Fix-up commit 2890254 closed CR-001 (NaN guard) and CR-002 (clamp to 0-100) with 6 new passing tests, confirmed RED before/GREEN after. User approved via 'continue'.
